_comment: Clip A2 (recording_shot_list.md): ground dash, dash-jump inside the window, air dash forward, W held throughout.
Timeline ticks are 1-based sim ticks at 64 Hz. They are a first guess: after extracting a trial, look at the
measured speed_h / vel_v curves and move 'from'/'to' so the jump and air dash start on the same tick as in
the video (tick = (video time - t0) * 64). One-tick presses have from == to (the sim derives press edges).
Alignment: t0 (measured time of tick 0) is found per run by matching the first rising crossing of
speed_h through value_u (the ground dash start) in the video and in the sim.
Bounds are search limits, not game limits: a result on a bound is flagged in the report.
